value.rationale: Quantitative Ritt theory normally bounds n||T^n-T^{n+1}|| but does not identify its complete long-time cluster set. Here the exact lower and upper limits undergo a sharp trichotomy as eigenvalue gaps become dense, geometric, or superlacunary, and their ratio reconstructs the spectral spacing q independently of the ray angle. Every allowed cluster interval appears even for compact perturbations of the identity in all Schatten classes, so these fine dynamical invariants are invisible to ordinary perturbative regularity. This is a motivated and complete natural classification rather than a routine Ritt-membership test.
